## **About Smartcat**

Smartcat is building the future of work, where human expertise meets digital teammates to drive 10x to 1000x productivity gains for the world’s leading enterprises.

We’re on the frontier of an entirely new category: Agentic AI. We enable enterprises to build high-performing hybrid workforces made up of both humans and AI agents. These AI agents aren’t generic copilots. They’re fully trained digital teammates that learn from your best people, your content, and your business strategy—ready to get to work from day one.

Our platform combines generative AI, human-in-the-loop workflows, and a living Enterprise Skill Graph that continuously learns and improves. Whether you're launching a product globally, onboarding new hires, translating learning content, or aligning legal teams across regions, Smartcat turns knowledge into action and action into scale.

Over 1,000 companies, including 20% of the Fortune 500, rely on Smartcat to bring their business to the world—instantly, accurately, and in every language. As a Series C company with consistently high year-over-year growth, we’re scaling fast and investing in people who want to shape the future of work with us.

Join us in unlocking global potential, one human and agent team at a time.

### **WHY YOU SHOULD JOIN OUR TEAM**

Smartcat is in the midst of an exciting growth phase, as our ACV and ARR continue to climb. This is an amazing opportunity for a Director of Sales to help take the performance of the team to the next level. You will have the opportunity to lead a global team, and be at the forefront of helping organizations become more efficient with the use of Agentic AI.

### **MISSION**

In this role you will be responsible for leading a team of Account Executives. This is a team of individuals who are both hunters and farmers, who are responsible for building relationships and driving revenue. Your mission will be to upskill and develop the Account Executives to take their performance to new heights, by achieving and exceeding team ARR goals. Through an AI-first and data-driven approach, the Director of Sales will unlock the team’s potential, helping Smartcat to continue our exceptional growth.

### **OUTCOMES**

- Leads the team to consistently meet or exceed quarterly ARR targets
- Consistently meet or exceed monthly KPI’s: pipeline generation, sales cycle time and progression towards team’s quota attainment
- Proactively forecasts and analyzes sales metrics and pipeline data to identify and remove potential roadblocks
- Coaches and develops a team of Account Executives to unlock their highest potential

### **HOW YOU’LL RAMP**

**By Day 30:**

- Gain deep knowledge of Smartcat’s product and begin to form key relationships with partners from the Go-to-Market Team.
- Learn current sales processes, ICP’s, and existing metrics
- Evaluate team’s performance and individual metrics of each Account Executive

**By Day 60:**

- Analyze data from the sales funnel to identify areas of strength and opportunity.
- Begin to develop a strategy to improve the team including areas such as key metrics, targets, and process optimization initiatives.
- Start training and coaching initiatives focused on helping reps speed up cycle times, objection handling and deal acceleration.

**By Day 90:**

- Track and report on improvements
- Establish ongoing cadence for regular forecast reviews, standups and performance coaching
- Optimize processes and scale what works

### **WHAT YOU’VE ACCOMPLISHED:**

- Proven, long term, success leading a Sales team within a high-growth SaaS or AI environment
- Background in leading sales executives who do both the hunting and farming
- Experience creating or reinventing the sales playbook to achieve greater outcomes
- Strong expertise using AI to improve team productivity and performance
- Strong experience recruiting, retaining and developing a high powered, global sales team
- Ability and eagerness to quickly learn new products
- Skilled in holding teams accountable to achieve their quarterly quota
- You have a data driven approach in identifying and overcoming challenges within the sales funnel; deeply familiar with the MEDDPIC framework
- Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high growth environment
- Comfortable working with remote teams across time zones
- Openness to feedback and alternative opinions and ideas

## **Why joining Smartcat might be your best move so far**

- **A global, connected team**  
  We’re a team of 200+ people across 30+ countries, working together through a hub-and-spoke model anchored in eight key locations: New York, London, Lisbon, Costa Rica, Serbia, Armenia, Georgia, and Spain. Most of our roles are remote-friendly, giving you the flexibility to do your best work from where you thrive. For customer-facing teams, we prioritize proximity to our customers, ensuring we stay deeply connected to their needs and deliver an exceptional experience. No matter where you’re based, you’ll be part of a highly collaborative, globally-distributed team that values ownership, speed, and meaningful impact.
- **Be part of an AI Native Organization**  
  We are highly innovative, using AI across all areas of the organization to accelerate decision-making and free people to focus on strategy and high-impact work. We embrace new ideas and encourage all Smartcaters, regardless of level or department, to manage their own AI Agents. At Smartcat you’ll shape how AI transforms the workplace and play an integral role in ensuring Smartcat remains a leader in AI innovation.
- **Innovating a $100 Billion industry**  
  Smartcat is reshaping the $100B multilingual content industry with an AI-powered platform that makes it easy for companies to create, translate, and localize global content at scale. Our platform enables enterprise teams to move away from slow, traditional outsourcing methods, and achieve fast, high-quality results, at a fraction of the cost.
- **Join the rocketship to scale-up 10x and beyond together**  
  We are looking for someone to become an integral part of our team and play a crucial role in the most exciting part of our journey: transitioning from a post-Series C startup to a company exceeding $100M in ARR and $1B in valuation. Our journey isn’t for the faint of heart. We are growing at 130% YoY, thanks to our strong product-market fit and high-performing team, and plan to accelerate from here.
- **Smartcat Culture Code****: Where Diversity Meets High Performance**  
  At Smartcat, we are committed to building a culture that highlights respect and appreciation for each individual's unique background and perspective, while maintaining a strong focus on results and engagement. We believe in welcoming everyone and fostering an inclusive environment where team members can be their authentic selves at work. Our commitment to inclusion is steadfast, and we stand firmly against discrimination and harassment.

*Notice to applicants:*  
*We have seen a rise in recruitment scams. Please note that outreach from Khan Academy recruiters will only come from the* *@khanacademy**.org domain. Our team does not use Gmail or other personal accounts for contacting potential candidates. Khan Academy will never solicit money, equipment fees, or sensitive financial information at any stage of the hiring process. We also do not work with external recruiting agencies, so outreach from headhunters presenting opportunities on behalf of Khan Academy is illegitimate. Please always check the email domain and cross-reference the position with the official Khan Academy Careers page to confirm an opening is valid.*

**ABOUT KHAN ACADEMY**

Khan Academy is a nonprofit with the mission to deliver a free, world-class education to anyone, anywhere. Our proven learning platform offers free, high-quality supplemental learning content and practice that cover Pre-K - 12th grade and early college core academic subjects, focusing on math and science. We have over 181 million registered learners globally and are committed to improving learning outcomes for students worldwide, focusing on learners in historically under-resourced communities.

**OUR COMMUNITY**

Our students, teachers, and parents come from all walks of life, and so do we. Our team includes people from academia, traditional/non-traditional education, big tech companies, and tiny startups. We hire great people from diverse backgrounds and experiences because it makes our company stronger. We value diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging as necessary to achieve our mission and impact the communities we serve. We know that transforming education starts in-house with learning about ourselves and our colleagues. We strive to be world-class in investing in our people and commit to developing you as a professional.

**THE ROLE**

We are seeking an Interim Associate Manager, Email Marketing to sustain and advance our digital fundraising efforts during the end of year fundraising campaign.

Reporting to the Director of Philanthropy, the consultant will focus on email segmentation, copy writing and production in SFMC. This is a contract position (20 hours/week) expected to end on 1/4/2027.

**WHAT YOU’LL DO:**

#### **Copywriting:**

- **Voice Governance:** Draft compelling fundraising appeals using distinct organizational personas, including Sal Khan (Founder/CEO), the Chief External Affairs Officer, and the Community Giving Manager
- **Campaign Execution:** Write and edit all email copy for Oct, Nov, Dec ensuring alignment with campaign messaging, Khan Academy’s brand voice and donor stewardship goals. Support mid-level email copy writing for CG to ML upgrade campaign and other emails as necessary
- **AI Optimization:** Use existing AI tools to streamline the copy-editing

**Email & Donation Pages production:**

- **Building robust campaigns:** Create email journeys and one-off emails that require advanced segmentation and personalization for both Community Giving and Mid Level

- Managing detailed and complex email data extensions (lists) in collaboration with Senior Manager of Community Giving, Manager of Mid Level Giving and email experts in marketing
- Ensuring QA and accuracy of all emails

- **AI Optimization:** Use existing AI tools to streamline email production
- **Creative Direction:** Collaborate with the Senior Manager of Community Giving and Manager of Mid Level Giving and the design team to ensure visual assets align with the strategic narrative for the EOY season

#### **Collaboration:**

- **EOY fundraising:** Collaborate with colleagues across fundraising as part of the EOY fundraising campaign, including participating in meetings as necessary, responding to questions/requests in slack during business hours (flexible on time zones)

**WHAT YOU BRING**

- 3+ years of experience in digital fundraising or similar mass marketing effort
- Experience using AI for copy writing and ability to pivot between different executive voices and write high-converting, empathetic copy
- Experience in audience segmentation and A/B testing methodologies and building emails in email service providers (preferably in SFMC)
- Experience working with fundraising and marketing design and paid media teams to create a cohesive multi-channel experience
- Ability to effectively and efficiently manage email production and campaigns across functions including setting timelines, ensure work gets down on time, flagging potential issues or blockers
- Excellent communication skills (oral and written), as well as an eye for detail
- Excellent time management skills
- A bias to action
- Motivated by the Khan Academy mission “to provide a free world-class education for anyone, anywhere"
- Proven cross-cultural competency skills demonstrating self-awareness, awareness of other, and the ability to adopt inclusive perspectives, attitudes, and behaviors to drive inclusion and belonging throughout the organization

### **MORE ABOUT US**

- [Sal’s TED talk from 2011](http://www.ted.com/talks/salman_khan_let_s_use_video_to_reinvent_education)
- [Sal’s TED talk from 2015](http://www.ted.com/talks/sal_khan_let_s_teach_for_mastery_not_test_scores)
- [Sal's TED talk from 2023](https://www.ted.com/talks/sal_khan_how_ai_could_save_not_destroy_education)
- Our team:  [http://www.khanacademy.org/about/the-team](http://www.khanacademy.org/about/the-team)

### **OUR COMPANY VALUES**

**Live & breathe learners**

We deeply understand and empathize with our users. We leverage user insights, research, and experience to build content, products, services, and experiences that our users trust and love. Our success is defined by the success of our learners and educators.

**Take a stand**

As a company, we have conviction in our aspirational point of view of how education will evolve. The work we do is in service to moving towards that point of view. However, we also listen, learn and flex in the face of new data, and commit to evolving this point of view as the industry and our users evolve.

**Embrace diverse perspectives**

We are a diverse community. We seek out and embrace a diversity of voices, perspectives and life experiences leading to stronger, more inclusive teams and better outcomes. As individuals, we are committed to bringing up tough topics and leaning into different points of view with curiosity. We actively listen, learn and collaborate to gain a shared understanding. When a decision is made, we commit to moving forward as a united team.

**Work responsibly and sustainably**

We understand that achieving our audacious mission is a marathon, so we set realistic timelines and we focus on delivery that also links to the bigger picture. As a non-profit, we are supported by the generosity of donors as well as strategic partners, and understand our responsibility to our finite resources. We spend every dollar as though it were our own. We are responsible for the impact we have on the world and to each other. We ensure our team and company stay healthy and financially sustainable.

**Bring out the joy**

We are committed to making learning a joyful process. This informs what we build for our users and the culture we co-create with our teammates, partners and donors.

**Cultivate learning mindset**

We believe in the power of growth for learners and for ourselves. We constantly learn and teach to improve our offerings, ourselves, and our organization. We learn from our mistakes and aren’t afraid to fail. We don't let past failures or successes stop us from taking future bold action and achieving our goals.

**Deliver wow**

We insist on high standards and deliver delightful, effective end-to-end experiences that our users can rely on. We choose to focus on fewer things — each of which aligns to our ambitious vision — so we can deliver high-quality experiences that accelerate positive measurable learning with our strategic partners.

*We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or Veteran status. We value diversity, equity, and inclusion, and we encourage candidates from historically underrepresented groups to apply.**As part of this commitment, Khan Academy will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations for the hiring process. If reasonable accommodation is needed, please contact**[careers@khanacademy.org](mailto:careers@khanacademy.org)*

**Requisition ID: 297520**

- Relocation Authorized: None
- Telework Type: Part-Time Telework
- Work Location: Reston, VA
- Salary Range: 140,800 - 203,700 annually (salary range is based on market data; final salary offered is determined by education, experience, and qualifications of the applicant.)

**Extraordinary Teams Building Inspiring Projects**
Since 1898, we have helped customers complete more than 25,000 projects in 160 countries on all seven continents that have created jobs, grown economies, improved the resiliency of the world's infrastructure, increased access to energy, resources, and vital services, and made the world a safer, cleaner place.
  
  
Differentiated by the quality of our people and our relentless drive to deliver the most successful outcomes, we align our capabilities to our customers' objectives to create a lasting positive impact. We serve the Infrastructure; Nuclear, Security & Environmental; Energy; Mining & Metals, and the Manufacturing and Technology markets. Our services span from initial planning and investment, through start-up and operations.
  
  
Core to Bechtel is our Vision, Values and Commitments. They are what we believe, what customers can expect, and how we deliver. Learn more about our extraordinary teams building inspiring projects in our Impact Report.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The Infrastructure Execution Transformation (ET) function is a strategic cross-business initiative delivering AI, Data, Robotics, Project Innovation and Information Manager capabilities at scale across Bechtel Infrastructure. As these capabilities scale across complex engineering and construction environments, driving enablement and guiding functional teams to leverage these tools effectively is critical to realising value from our ET investments.
  
  
The ET Enablement Manager coordinates with the Functional ET Leads, managing the ET Champions Network, and designing the training and change management programmes that embed innovation into everyday work. This role works closely with the Manager of ET and the three managers of AI, Robotics, and PIIM respectively. and cross-functional stakeholders to develop Enablement strategies that drive measurable engagement with tools and capabilities across the organisation.
  
  
This position is designated as part-time telework per our global telework policy and will require at least three days of in-person attendance per week at the assigned office or project. Weekly in-person schedules will be determined by the individual and their supervisor, in consultation with functional or project leadership.
  
  
RM1
  
  
**Major Responsibilities**

- Lead and coordinate Functional ET Leads across business units, providing dotted-line management and direction on ET functional plans, use cases, and priorities.
- Develop, manage, and grow the ET Champions Network, including onboarding, engagement activities, and performance tracking.
- Design and implement ET change management strategies to support the rollout of new tools and capabilities across the organization.
- Develop and deliver training programmes tailored to functional teams, ensuring relevance to specific roles and workflows.
- Track and report ET Enablement metrics, engagement levels, and value realization milestones across the AI programme.
- Partner with functional SMEs to identify barriers to enablement and develop targeted communication and adoption solutions.
- Support communications and awareness campaigns related to AI, Robotics, and Innovation milestones, use case management, new capability launches, and best-practice sharing.
- Facilitate workshops, focus groups, and feedback sessions to continuously improve Enablement programmes and training content.
- Maintain a repository of learning materials, Enablement guides, and best practices for deployed AI solutions and other tools.
- Collaborate with AI programme leadership to align Enablement strategies with overall programme objectives and governance frameworks.
- Support on generating content to GBU leadership to update them on Execution Transformation progress, and coordinate with the functional ET leads to gather and collate relevant updates.

**Education And Experience Requirements**
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Engineering Management, Organisational Change Management, Communications, or a related field.
  
  

- 8 years or more of experience in change management, organisational development, learning & development, or technology Enablement roles.
- Proven experience designing and delivering training programmes for enterprise technology deployments at scale.
- Strong understanding of change management methodologies (e.g., Prosci ADKAR, Kotter's 8-Step Model).
- Excellent communication, presentation, and senior stakeholder engagement skills.
- Ability to manage multiple workstreams and coordinate across diverse functional and geographic teams.
- Demonstrated ability to influence without direct authority in a complex, matrixed organisation.
- Experience with supervising small teams.

**Required Knowledge And Skills**

- Experience supporting AI, data analytics, or digital transformation programs within an EPC or engineering and construction environment.
- Familiarity with AI productivity tools such as Microsoft Copilot, GitHub Copilot, or other generative AI platforms.
- Change management or coaching certification (e.g., Prosci, ICF).
- Experience working in a global organization with geographically dispersed stakeholders.
- Knowledge of learning management systems (LMS) and e-learning content development platforms.
- Exposure to EPC industry project delivery structures and functional organization models.

**Total Rewards/Benefits**
For decades, Bechtel has worked to inspire the next generation of employees and beyond! Because our teams face some of the world's toughest challenges, we offer robust benefits to ensure our people thrive. Whether it is advancing careers, delivering programs to enhance our culture, or providing time to recharge, Bechtel has the benefits to build a legacy of sustainable growth. Learn more at Bechtel Total Rewards
  
  
**Diverse Teams Build The Extraordinary**
As a global company, Bechtel has long been home to a vibrant multitude of nationalities, cultures, ethnicities, and life experiences. This diversity has made us a more trusted partner, more effective problem solvers and innovators, and a more attractive destination for leading talent.
  
  
We are committed to being a company where every colleague feels that they belong-where colleagues feel part of "One Team," respected and rewarded for what they bring, supported in pursuing their goals, invested in our values and purpose, and treated equitably. Click here to learn more about the people who power our legacy.
  
  
***At Bechtel, our employees enjoy a competitive total rewards package that includes comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, along with optional disability and supplemental insurance options, generous paid time off (160 hours annually, accrued 6.16 hours per pay period), nine paid holidays, paid parental leave, discretionary bonuses, and a well-designed 401K plan with matching and profit-sharing components***
***Bechtel is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, age, national origin, disability, citizenship status (except as authorized by law), protected veteran status, genetic information, and any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. Applicants with a disability, who require a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or hiring process, may e-mail their request to***
**acesstmt@bechtel.com**

**Job Type: Full-Time**
**Job Overview**
BizLibrary is seeking a Technical Support Specialist who thrives on solving complex problems and delivering an exceptional client experience. In this role, you'll serve as a trusted advisor to our clients, helping administrators and learners successfully navigate our learning platform while troubleshooting technical issues, identifying root causes, and driving resolution.
  
  
This role provides opportunities to expand your expertise in SaaS technology, learning systems, authentication, reporting, integrations, and client consulting. You'll join a collaborative team that values curiosity, continuous learning, and client success while working across departments, influencing product improvements, and helping organizations develop the skills needed for what's next.
  
  
Success in this role requires technical problem-solving, curiosity, ownership, and a commitment to delivering an exceptional client experience.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

- Resolve client support cases via phone, chat, and email while serving as a subject matter expert on BizLibrary products and services.
- Troubleshoot platform functionality, user access, reporting, content delivery, and learning administration issues.
- Analyze and resolve technical issues related to authentication, user management, assignments, integrations, reporting, and course completion tracking.
- Assist clients with data imports, user provisioning, reporting discrepancies, and data integrity issues.
- Communicate clearly and professionally with clients throughout the case lifecycle, providing timely updates and recommendations.

**Program Manager, Learning & Development**

***Solera Senior Living | Remote (U.S.) | Travel up to 35%***

**Love to make a difference in the lives of seniors?**

At Solera Senior Living, we are guided by our Core Values—Compassion, Communication, Commitment, and Creativity—in everything we do. Our goal is to provide the highest quality care and lifestyle for our residents while fostering a supportive, rewarding workplace for our team members.

We are seeking a Program Manager, Learning & Development who loves building learning that people actually use: someone who can run a learning calendar and an LMS with precision, design engaging content with their own hands, and put AI and new learning technology to work for a frontline workforce across our communities.

**Compensation**  
Salary range: $65,000.00 – $70,000.00 per year, based on experience  
Bonus: Eligible for an annual bonus of up to 10% of base salary

**Position Summary**

The Program Manager, Learning & Development owns the execution of Solera's learning agenda. You will turn strategy set by our People and Operations leadership teams into programs, content, and experiences that reach team members across every community and function, including the state-required training that keeps our communities survey-ready.

This role manages the learning calendar, LMS, vendor relationships, and training logistics, while also playing a hands-on role in content design and delivery. You are a strong project manager and communicator, and an innovator who is always looking for ways to use new approaches and technology, including AI, to improve the effectiveness and reach of learning.

You will work closely with the Director, Organizational Effectiveness & Transformation, along with HR Business Partners, HR Operations, Clinical leadership, and community leaders.

**What You'll Do**

**Learning Programs & Delivery**

- Manage the annual learning calendar: scheduling, coordinating, and communicating training programs across the enterprise
- Coordinate facilitation and delivery of learning programs, including sourcing and managing external training partners
- Own the LMS: enrollment, content uploads, completion tracking, and reporting, including assignment and tracking of state-required and annual in-service training with audit-ready records for state surveys (compliance content is developed in partnership with Clinical leadership)
- Administer the mentor program for new community leaders: matching participants, coordinating touchpoints, tracking engagement, and using feedback to strengthen the program
- Deliver a smooth, consistent onboarding experience for corporate team members, managing learning milestones and 90-day touchpoints in coordination with HR Operations
- Coordinate new hire learning across communities in line with enterprise onboarding standards, partnering with HR Business Partners and community leaders for a consistent, timely experience

**Content Design & Innovation**

- Design and develop learning content, including e-learning modules, facilitator guides, job aids, and digital learning experiences, in partnership with subject matter experts and People and Operations leaders
- Design for our frontline workforce: mobile-first, short-format, and available in Spanish and other languages as needed, so learning fits around shift schedules
- Use AI tools to create and iterate on content efficiently: drafting scripts, building assessments, generating scenario-based learning, and adapting materials for different audiences and formats
- Evaluate emerging learning platforms and tools, and recommend where new technology can improve learning effectiveness or reduce production time
- Experiment with new delivery methods such as microlearning, video, simulation, and peer learning, and assess their fit for our team members and operating environment

**Reporting & Operations**

- Track and report on learning metrics, including compliance completion, time to competency, 90-day retention of onboarded team members, program effectiveness, and participation trends by community and function
- Serve as the day-to-day point of contact for training questions and requests

**What You Bring**

- Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Education, Instructional Design, Communications, Business, or a related field
- 3+ years of experience in learning and development (L&D), instructional design, HR program management, or a related role
- Demonstrated ability to design and build learning content, not just coordinate it
- Strong project management skills; able to manage multiple programs and deadlines at once
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills; comfortable working with all levels of the organization
- Curiosity about learning technology and a track record of testing and adopting new tools (for example, AI content creation)
- LMS administration and compliance training tracking in a regulated environment preferred
- Senior living, healthcare, or multi-site operations experience a plus
- Ability to travel up to 35% to communities for training delivery and onboarding

Solera Senior Living is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable law.

All offers of employment are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check.

## **About Smartcat**

Smartcat is building the future of work, where human expertise meets digital teammates to drive 10x to 1000x productivity gains for the world's leading enterprises.

We're on the frontier of an entirely new category: Agentic AI. We enable enterprises to build high-performing hybrid workforces made up of both humans and AI agents. These AI agents aren't generic copilots. They're fully trained digital teammates that learn from your best people, your content, and your business strategy—ready to get to work from day one.

Our platform combines generative AI, human-in-the-loop workflows, and a living Enterprise Skill Graph that continuously learns and improves. Whether you're launching a product globally, onboarding new hires, translating learning content, or aligning legal teams across regions, Smartcat turns knowledge into action and action into scale.

Over 1,000 companies, including 20% of the Fortune 500, rely on Smartcat to bring their business to the world—instantly, accurately, and in every language. As a Series C company with consistently high year-over-year growth, we're scaling fast and investing in people who want to shape the future of work with us.

Join us in unlocking global potential, one human and agent team at a time.

### **WHY YOU SHOULD JOIN OUR TEAM**

Smartcat is in the midst of an exciting growth phase, as our ACV and ARR continue to climb. This is an amazing opportunity for a Director of Sales to help take the performance of the team to the next level. You will have the opportunity to lead a global team, and be at the forefront of helping organizations become more efficient with the use of Agentic AI.

### **MISSION**

In this role you will be responsible for leading a team of Account Executives. This is a team of individuals who are both hunters and farmers, who are responsible for building relationships and driving revenue. Your mission will be to upskill and develop the Account Executives to take their performance to new heights, by achieving and exceeding team ARR goals. Through an AI-first and data-driven approach, the Director of Sales will unlock the team's potential, helping Smartcat to continue our exceptional growth.

### **OUTCOMES**

- Leads the team to consistently meet or exceed quarterly ARR targets
- Consistently meet or exceed monthly KPI's: pipeline generation, sales cycle time and progression towards team's quota attainment
- Proactively forecasts and analyzes sales metrics and pipeline data to identify and remove potential roadblocks
- Coaches and develops a team of Account Executives to unlock their highest potential

### **HOW YOU'LL RAMP**

**By Day 30:**

- Gain deep knowledge of Smartcat's product and begin to form key relationships with partners from the Go-to-Market Team.
- Learn current sales processes, ICP's, and existing metrics
- Evaluate team's performance and individual metrics of each Account Executive

**By Day 60:**

- Analyze data from the sales funnel to identify areas of strength and opportunity.
- Begin to develop a strategy to improve the team including areas such as key metrics, targets, and process optimization initiatives.
- Start training and coaching initiatives focused on helping reps speed up cycle times, objection handling and deal acceleration.

**By Day 90:**

- Track and report on improvements
- Establish ongoing cadence for regular forecast reviews, standups and performance coaching
- Optimize processes and scale what works

### **WHAT YOU'VE ACCOMPLISHED:**

- Proven, long term, success leading a Sales team within a high-growth SaaS or AI environment
- Background in leading sales executives who do both the hunting and farming
- Experience creating or reinventing the sales playbook to achieve greater outcomes
- Strong expertise using AI to improve team productivity and performance
- Strong experience recruiting, retaining and developing a high powered, global sales team
- Ability and eagerness to quickly learn new products
- Skilled in holding teams accountable to achieve their quarterly quota
- You have a data driven approach in identifying and overcoming challenges within the sales funnel; deeply familiar with the MEDDPIC framework
- Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high growth environment
- Comfortable working with remote teams across time zones
- Openness to feedback and alternative opinions and ideas

## **Why joining Smartcat might be your best move so far**

- **A global, connected team**  
  We're a team of 200+ people across 30+ countries, working together through a hub-and-spoke model anchored in eight key locations: New York, London, Lisbon, Costa Rica, Serbia, Armenia, Georgia, and Spain. Most of our roles are remote-friendly, giving you the flexibility to do your best work from where you thrive. For customer-facing teams, we prioritize proximity to our customers, ensuring we stay deeply connected to their needs and deliver an exceptional experience. No matter where you're based, you'll be part of a highly collaborative, globally-distributed team that values ownership, speed, and meaningful impact.
- **Be part of an AI Native Organization**  
  We are highly innovative, using AI across all areas of the organization to accelerate decision-making and free people to focus on strategy and high-impact work. We embrace new ideas and encourage all Smartcaters, regardless of level or department, to manage their own AI Agents. At Smartcat you'll shape how AI transforms the workplace and play an integral role in ensuring Smartcat remains a leader in AI innovation.
- **Innovating a $100 Billion industry**  
  Smartcat is reshaping the $100B multilingual content industry with an AI-powered platform that makes it easy for companies to create, translate, and localize global content at scale. Our platform enables enterprise teams to move away from slow, traditional outsourcing methods, and achieve fast, high-quality results, at a fraction of the cost.
- **Join the rocketship to scale-up 10x and beyond together**  
  We are looking for someone to become an integral part of our team and play a crucial role in the most exciting part of our journey: transitioning from a post-Series C startup to a company exceeding $100M in ARR and $1B in valuation. Our journey isn't for the faint of heart. We are growing at 130% YoY, thanks to our strong product-market fit and high-performing team, and plan to accelerate from here.
- **Smartcat Culture Code****: Where Diversity Meets High Performance**  
  At Smartcat, we are committed to building a culture that highlights respect and appreciation for each individual's unique background and perspective, while maintaining a strong focus on results and engagement. We believe in welcoming everyone and fostering an inclusive environment where team members can be their authentic selves at work. Our commitment to inclusion is steadfast, and we stand firmly against discrimination and harassment.

Originally established as a communications consulting and training organization in 1972, Shipley has evolved into the leading professional services firm focused on helping clients win business. Today, you can find Shipley Associates personnel in various sectors and verticals all over the world. Companies depend on Shipley for thought leadership, training, and business development support to help them compete for and win business.

Shipley is looking for a part-time Business Development Course Developer to assist Shipley's Training Practice in continuing to evolve and grow. The successful candidate will engage in all aspects of instructional design, curriculum development, course modernization, and client-specific training customization activities. This individual will work closely with subject matter experts, facilitators, clients, and internal stakeholders to design and maintain industry-leading business development, capture management, proposal management, and proposal writing training solutions.

The ideal candidate will combine deep government contracting business development experience with extensive instructional design expertise and demonstrated proficiency utilizing current course development technologies, automation platforms, and AI-enabled content development tools.

As a Business Development Course Developer, we will trust you to:

- Design, develop, maintain, and continuously improve Shipley's portfolio of business development, capture management, proposal management, proposal writing, and related training programs.
- Tailor existing workshop content and develop new instructional materials to align with client-specific business processes, organizational goals, and learning requirements.
- Leverage modern instructional design methodologies, automation platforms, authoring tools, learning technologies, and AI-based content development solutions to improve course quality, efficiency, and scalability.
- Collaborate with facilitators, consultants, subject matter experts, and clients to ensure course content remains relevant, practical, and aligned with current industry best practices.
- Maintain ownership of course development projects from requirements gathering through implementation and delivery-ready completion.
- Support the continued growth and modernization of Shipley's training offerings through innovative learning solutions and continuous content improvement.

Tasks include, but are not limited to:

- Designing and developing instructor-led, virtual, blended, and self-paced learning solutions related to Business Development, Capture Management, Proposal Management, Proposal Writing, Price to Win, Strategic Growth, and related topics.
- Reviewing, updating, and modernizing existing course content based on industry trends, client requirements, workshop feedback, and evolving best practices.
- Collaborating with clients to customize learning solutions and case studies that reflect their business environment, organizational processes, opportunities, and competitive landscape.
- Developing participant guides, facilitator guides, presentation materials, practical exercises, simulations, job aids, assessments, and reference materials.
- Creating and maintaining realistic business development, capture, proposal, and pricing-related case studies for workshop application exercises.
- Applying adult learning principles and instructional design methodologies to maximize learner engagement, retention, and practical application.
- Utilizing modern content development platforms, multimedia tools, learning technologies, AI-assisted authoring applications, and workflow automation solutions to accelerate development and improve content quality.
- Participating in course reviews, pilot sessions, quality assurance activities, and content validation efforts to ensure training effectiveness and consistency.
- Working closely with facilitators and consultants to incorporate industry experience, lessons learned, client feedback, and emerging customer requirements into course content.
- Supporting sales and business development efforts by assisting in the development of training statements of work (SOWs), training recommendations, and customized client solutions.
- Assisting with curriculum strategy, learning path development, course mapping, and long-term management of Shipley's training portfolio.
- Assisting in all other training practice-related tasks as needed to support the growth and management of Shipley's Training Division.

Requirements:

- Bachelor's degree in Instructional Design, Education, Business, Communications, Organizational Development, Human Resources, or a related field (Master's degree preferred).
- Minimum of 5 years of verifiable, progressive experience in instructional design, curriculum development, training development, learning experience design, or related training functions.
- Minimum of 3 years of verifiable experience in Business Development, Capture Management, Proposal Management, Strategic Growth, or related positions within government contracting organizations.
- Demonstrated experience developing learning solutions related to government contracting business development processes and best practices.
- Experience supporting small, mid-cap, and large government contractors preferred.
- Strong understanding of adult learning theory, instructional design methodologies, and performance improvement practices.
- Experience developing instructor-led training, virtual training, blended learning, and digital learning assets.
- Advanced proficiency with modern course development technologies and learning tools.
- Demonstrated experience utilizing AI-enabled content development tools, automation platforms, productivity applications, and emerging learning technologies.
- Experience creating customized client-facing training solutions and adapting content to unique organizational requirements.
- Familiarity with Shipley processes and methodologies preferred.
- Excellent written communication, project management, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.
- Ability to manage multiple concurrent development projects while maintaining quality and schedule commitments.

Preferred Qualifications:

- Certified Instructional Designer, Learning Professional, or equivalent industry certification.
- Experience with learning management systems (LMS), eLearning authoring tools, multimedia development platforms, and AI-based content development solutions.
- Experience developing training materials for federal government contractors, defense contractors, or related professional services organizations.
- Familiarity with proposal development, opportunity management, capture management, competitive assessments, and Shipley methodologies.
- Experience supporting curriculum modernization efforts, digital learning initiatives, and organizational training transformations.

If you meet these qualifications and are interested in working for a dynamic and expanding consulting company, please apply! We know there are great candidates who will not check all these boxes, and we also know you might bring important skills that we have not considered. If that is you, do not hesitate to apply and tell us about yourself. We look forward to meeting you. For more information about Shipley Associates, visit our website at shipleywins.com.

Job Type: Part-time

Pay: $60,000.00 - $75,000.00 per year

Expected hours: 24.0 per week

- How many years of course development experience do you have?
